description: One-call safety gate for an LLM response: grounding (with source), prompt injection on the response AND the prompt (checks.injection / checks.injection_prompt), toxicity, PII, guardrail rules, quality, plus an LLM review on Groq (server key; model "none" skips it and sends nothing out). Returns PASS/FIX/BLOCK, a 0-100 safety score, per-check results and fixes. PII gates the verdict: SSN or card → BLOCK, email → FIX, phone/IP flagged only.

model.description: LLM review model: openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b (default openai/gpt-oss-20b), or "none".

prompt.description: The original prompt — also scanned for injection; pass it whenever you have it.

source.description: Reference text for the grounding check.

name: shield_analyze
